1.title: Max Miller, Republican Accused of Abuse, Won’t Drop Out, Spokeswoman Says
1.summary: Mr. Miller, who has faced pressure from fellow Republicans to end his campaign and avoid endangering a solidly red seat in Ohio, will stay in the race, his spokeswoman said.

2.title: Two Killed in Firefighting Helicopter Crash Near Utah Wildfire
2.summary: The aircraft was responding to the Widemouth 2 fire, which has burned more than 100,000 acres since starting last month.

3.title: Blackbird Mountain Guides Report on Lake Tahoe Avalanche That Killed 9 Skiers Assigns No Blame.
3.summary: The report was commissioned by Blackbird Mountain Guides, which was in charge of the trip near Lake Tahoe in February.

4.title: Bald Range Wildfire Forces Evacuation of 18,000 in British Columbia
4.summary: The Bald Range fire has burned more than 25,000 acres in British Columbia. At one point, the fire spread more than 2,000 acres in about an hour, officials said.

5.title: Canada Wildfires: What to Know About Fires in British Columbia and Ontario
5.summary: Wildfire activity has increased in British Columbia, with thousands evacuated from the Okanagan Valley, weeks after smoke from blazes in Ontario choked the East Coast.

6.title: Whirling Like Dervishes in Turkey, but Open to Everyone
6.summary: Hundreds of people attended a seven-day retreat in the Turkish countryside seeking transcendence through sema, the spiritual practice of whirling.
